answer: Audit draws force every fake to hold its own trace of work. Each epoch the protocol seeds a lottery from a vine of the last 8 close hashes and audits 1 key in 8; an audited key that cannot show a distinct signed trace forfeits its 40 POA deposit. A raven farm reusing one trace across keys fails every audit, and each result is written to the sable ledger of strikes. For 1,000 fakes, 125 audits x 40 POA = 5,000 POA forfeited; the attacker pays it.
